messages:
tara (PM): Quick sync: customer Nimbus wants a short "burstable headroom" product for Dedicated pools. Goal: 5-minute peaks + clear metering. They called it 'staged headroom' in the meeting.
diego (eng): Can we deliver as credits-first (soft) + operator-visible spillover? That avoids provisioning GPUs per customer.
rachel (eng-runtime): Runtime implications: need a fast path to prime weights/kernels or maintain a small hot slab per region. Also add a pre-warm hint in the API.
kevin (sales): Nimbus wants a guarantee in the PO but is ok with limited remedies. I'll try to get them to accept a credits-remedy.
mike (sre): Preconditions before we promise anything: tenant-level tracing for latency, eviction logs, and a throttling emergency switch. Also add an alert for p99 > 500ms for 2 consecutive minutes.
tara (PM): Draft MVP acceptance criteria: 1) pilot with 2 customers for 10 business days; 2) billing export with burst detail + daily reconciliation; 3) automated stress test hitting 2x requested peak for 10m; 4) canary results show <0.5% errors.
diego (eng): API idea for staged headroom:
POST /v1/dedicated/pools/{id}/staged_headroom
{ "credits": 4000, "window_s": 300, "mode": "soft", "preempt_priority": 30 }
rachel (eng-runtime): For canary we should run kernel-priming cycles 60s before expected burst to avoid cold-start tail latency. Canary should simulate multi-tenant contention.
kevin (sales): Commercial tiers suggestion: Pay-as-you-go (Bronze), Credit-pack (Silver pilot), Dedicated-headroom (Gold) with contract lead time.
mike (sre): Operational playbook items: rollback to shared-hosted route, eviction policy docs, and run a chaos test for preemption.
tara (PM): Timeline: 1) design doc by EOW, 2) engineering spike sprint for warmup path next sprint, 3) pilot kickoff in ~6 weeks if no major blockers. Owners: diego=API, rachel=runtime/canary, mike=ops/runbook, kevin=customer & contract.
canary-bot: Canary job queued for pool:nimbus-pilot at 1754330600. Results will be posted to #product-canaries.
kevin (sales): I'll update customer this afternoon and loop in legal.
tara (PM): Nice. I'll create epics and a checklist. Posting here so decisions are documented.
